notes: Curated starting notes for VSF-attributed listings already named on model dossiers. A factory label on a listing is a claim, not a conclusion from photos. Known variance below is what buyers should ask to see; it is not proof that a submitted photo shows a defect.

versions.label: Current curated notes
versions.notes: Version is not resolved from listing photos in this MVP. Treat this as a single qualitative snapshot, not a production-date score.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Straight-on dial photo in even light so date-window alignment can be discussed.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the date changes through the month, lume duration, or how the dial looks in person under mixed lighting.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A sharp dial photo that shows lume plot shape and placement on the markers.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Lume brightness after hours, color shift, or consistency across a batch.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A rehaut photo that shows whether laser etching is visible around the inner ring.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Etching depth, durability, or how the rehaut looks off-camera at other angles.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Close photos of clasp code and end-link fit against the case.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the clasp feels in hand, long-term wear, or bracelet stretch.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A straight-on dial photo so date centering in the window can be discussed.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Cyclops magnification in person or how centering looks at other wrist angles.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A rehaut photo that shows inner-ring alignment relative to the dial.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Whether alignment holds after shipping or after the crystal is disturbed.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Photos of solid end-link fit against the case lugs.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Gap feel on the wrist or how the bracelet sits after a few weeks of wear.
